systems.system: Sistema de Informação de Gestão Escolar (SIGE)
systems.country_label: SIGE; also called the EMIS and the School Management System
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, GEPE (Gabinete de Estudos, Planeamento e Estatística); scaled up from a UNESCO pilot with IDA funds and absorbed by GEPE
systems.tiers: GEPE at the centre with one official in each province, and provincial and municipal staff trained in data collection; schools answer a questionnaire, collected offline where there is no internet
yearly national return; annuals prepared for 2016 and 2019

note: SIGE is described as the means of collecting the schools' questionnaire for the yearly Cadastro and the statistical annuals, with no entry per learner by schools, so it is a census and gives no fact.
